name: Chimamanda Ngozi Adichie
shortBio: Nigerian public philosopher and writer whose critiques of "the danger of a single story" and global gender norms popularized epistemic justice and African feminist ethics.
centralQuestion: How do asymmetrical narratives produce epistemic injustice, and why does feminism require dismantling single-story stereotypes?

keyWorks.title: We Should All Be Feminists
keyWorks.description: Influential philosophical essay diagnosing everyday patriarchal conditioning and proposing an inclusive 21st-century feminist ethics.
